# DELETE /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}

Delete a package and all its versions

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-201`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| type | path | string | True |
| name | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Package does not exist

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [services](../modules/services.md) | PackageAssignmentAPI middleware | utility | Determine access mode; Look up package by name; Build minimal PackageDescriptor with Package and Owner |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | packages.DeletePackage | controller | Call packages_service.RemovePackage |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | packages_service.RemovePackage | service | Get all package descriptors; Call spec manager OnBeforeRemovePackageAll; Within transaction: delete properties, files, versions, package; Notify PackageDelete for each version |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Package access mode is determined by owner type (org vs user) and doer relationship | authorization | Owner is org: check team permissions; Owner is user: check if doer is owner or visibility is public/limited |
| Package deletion uses deferred blob cleanup - blobs are not deleted immediately from storage | business_logic | Always on package deletion |

| medium | n_plus_1_queries | GetAllPackageDescriptors loads all versions then builds descriptor for each one individually | Since descriptors are only needed for notifications, consider a lighter-weight approach for the delete path |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P3] query_optimization**: For deletion, only minimal descriptor info is needed for notifications. Use a lighter query that doesn't load all files/blobs/properties — *Impact: Reduce pre-deletion query load significantly for packages with many versions*

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | low | Deletion is wrapped in db.WithTx - all deletes are atomic within a transaction |
| idempotency | ✅ configured | low | If package doesn't exist, middleware returns 404 before handler runs. Safe to retry. |
| cascading_failure | — not_applicable | medium | Blob storage cleanup is deferred to cron task. If cron fails, orphaned blobs accumulate but don't affect functionality. |

**Cascading failure risk:** Low - deferred blob cleanup means storage won't be freed immediately but no data inconsistency

**Graceful degradation:** Returns 500 on DB failure; blob cleanup handled asynchronously by cron
